behavior.resize: Empty filename returns true before size validation. Nonempty: dimensions positive; signed32 product <=9000000 enters resize directly. Larger products choose first divisor1..999 with trunc(product/divisor^2)<9000000 then recursively Resize(width/divisor,height/divisor); outer stores divisor even recursive false. Fit by source aspect in branch order, truncate toward zero; align fitted width (width+3)&~3 before 24bit CreateDib and StretchBlt. Storage grayscale loops floor(storageSize/3) triples.
behavior.pixels: HALFTONE stretch mode4, SRCCOPY0x00cc0020; grayscale source SSE computes (byte2*0.299+byte1*0.589)+byte0*0.111 then truncates integer and writes low byte to all three channels. White255 yields254. No conventional0.587 substitution.
behavior.trace: Constructor initializes plane, zero width/height and flags. SetFilename compares requested gray and case-insensitive filename; changed path invalidates two caches with requested filename and OLD gray value before storing new filename/gray. Active document bitmap table lookup(load=true) determines success; missing active context returns false. Cache internals unresolved.
behavior.failure: Missing bitmap or failed Dib destroys existing wallpaper DIB and returns false. Successful DIB creation requires storage and destination DC; failed CreateDib path returns false. StretchBlt return is not used by this method; do not infer pixel correctness from true.

managedBoundary: Portable size plan and actual BGR storage transform only. Nonpositive inputs and signed32 product overflow explicitly rejected; zero reduced input distinguished from zero-size aspect allocation. No decode/resample/GDI/display/SetView/PC equivalence claim.

golden.method: JavaScript Math.trunc applied to same ordered source products; iterate R outer, B middle, G inner, append three gray bytes each. Independently executed implementation language, not original runtime oracle.
